notes.title: See you on Nov.12th! 20% off for first launch, see details for more game content
notes.content:
Hello, store managers! 
After intensive development, we can finally announce this news to you:

[b]<Lower?Higher!> The official version will be released on November 12, 2024![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990588/e12020cbc055ebb50a64ae585d7562c6a1b6cc14.png[/img]
————————————————
In the official version, as the new store manager, you will face more challenges:
Nearly 60 characters and hundreds of props! The illustration system is open, get them all!
Nearly 50 events have hit, they are closely related to your store manager life, please don’t take it lightly...
Two months of the main plot is online, and the dual endings have begun. Which path will you choose?
The signal of the delivery system has been strengthened! More than 20 orders have been covered by all White Star!
Graphics updates, animation optimization and a newly upgraded operating system! 
Leave a trophy for your store manager career: Achievements are newly launched!
as well as,
More fun ways to play! 
The sponsorship system, more products and customers, events, etc. are being developed...

Finally, thank you again for your support! If you like it, you can recommend it to your friends

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2913660/_/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990588/3591dce41bfee9d821d08d87aed12f7f08f1da3d.jpg[/img]
